text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —In short, my legs were in a state where it wouldn't have been surprising if I suddenly couldn't run anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Kikuka-sho.
Agnes Tachyon visited the Trainer's room and said that the very moment she opened her mouth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At this sudden, unexpected confession,
I reflexively stand up from my chair.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
These legs possess natural speed,
but also a fragile vulnerability.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kuku! What a terrible look on your face!
Well, I thought it might be a bit shocking, so
I kept quiet until now, and it looks like I was right!
choice_data_list: What are you talking about all of a sudden...?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"It's about my secret. I promised you, didn't I?
That if things went well, I'd tell you everything."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: You've worked quite hard, for a guinea pig. Consider this a little reward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that brief preface, she spoke once more
as the evening sun shone down on her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...You already know that I am captivated
by the Umamusume physique."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
She looks human on the outside, but her muscle power is many times greater.
Just how far can this marvelous physique take her—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Even as a child, I thought anyone not chasing this romance had to be lying. Well, I still think so now, actually.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, I possess a talent for running.
That is why I want to reach that place with my own eyes and my own legs.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: However, as expected... it proved rather difficult for the reasons I mentioned earlier.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The engine was magnificent, but the frame was fragile.
It couldn't handle even the slightest strain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The fact that she was whimsical, and didn't
immediately make a decision about entering the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The reason for all of it
lay entirely in her legs."
choice_data_list: So there was a secret like that...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Well, so with that in mind, I began two studies.
Plan A and Plan B.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Plan A is the reinforcement of my legs.
It is an experiment—and its accompanying etcetera—aimed at reaching the limit with my own legs.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Plan B is an experiment where I give up on reaching the limit with my own legs, and instead have another Umamusume reach it in my place.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I was conducting these two research projects in parallel. It was during that time that you became my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You believed in my legs.
We were so determined to compete in the Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon closed her eyes,
as if reminiscing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "With you, it's not just a dream!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "‘With you, it's not just a dream!’"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you're free to get your hopes up.
I won't deny you that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I dreamed a little when the Classic races were proposed, too. But reality is reality.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Having run in the Satsuki Sho... I knew in my heart
that my legs simply couldn't endure such a grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—When we spoke about future plans after the Satsuki Sho,
she insisted with unusual force that she "could not promise to race."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The mysteries behind every single one
of Agnes Tachyon's actions are coming to light.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, research on Plan A wasn't progressing well.
I didn't think it would make it in time during my peak."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That's why I pivoted to Plan B.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Plan B means aiming to reach the limit not with her own legs, but with another Umamusume's—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Which means... she was actually going to give up on running altogether...?!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...From then on, as if willing to ruin her own legs,
she gathered data for drugs to be tested on other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I decided to enter the Laurel Cup too.
It would be a waste not to gather data
on such a grand stage."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However, in the midst of all that,
you, knowing nothing—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Because you said something like,
"I want to see what lies beyond the limit together."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...I have a habit of being drawn to peculiar things, you see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
“—As long as the possibility isn't zero,
it's too early to give up.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I finally understood the meaning behind
the words she had one-sidedly thrown at me before.
choice_data_list: So that's why she declined afterwards...!
So that's why you declined afterwards...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's just how it is. Irrationally enough,
I gave in to the impulse to bet on Plan A.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, perhaps I should say you dug it up.
You've really stirred up quite a troublesome mess.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Still... in the end, it was my choice. Possibility is a poison of its own, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It eats away at you without you noticing, until one day
you can't even withstand the slightest impact.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Murmuring as if talking to herself,
she let out a small breath.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's why I finally made up my mind.
Not to give up, and to explore Plan A until the very last moment.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Even if it broke my legs, I intended to gather data, but withdrawing from the Laurel Cup—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I poured all my time into my research. After all,
I simply had to make it in time.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And... at summer camp, I finally saw the light at the end of the tunnel. My body can endure it now...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Plan A's verification stage."
On the day she said that, Agnes Tachyon had indeed pushed her body to the limit for the first time in days.
choice_data_list: (And on that day, it was undeniably a "success"—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I hold my head in my hands as the truth about Agnes Tachyon becomes clear piece by piece.
choice_data_list: So that's what was going on!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
That's why I was able to make up my mind to run in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her aloof attitude and playful tone
had tricked me, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Running the Kikuka-sho convinced me. I can run all the way through the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: So today... let us make a special promise, just the one.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As a little bonus along the way
to reaching beyond the limit—
I shall present you with a few victories.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now then, let's hear all about your plans for the Senior year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her words, completely unimaginable just a few days ago, made my throat tremble. A surge of emotion welled up inside me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —Hahaha! Don't cry, my dear Guinea Pig!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I went through all the trouble of making this a happy ending.
The least you could do is give me a smile."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. I see.
Come to think of it, that's just the kind of person you are.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, that reminds me. Since we're here,
shall I measure your current stress levels?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I happen to be rather interested in emotions right now.
Here, let me check your pulse at your fingertips."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What is the problem? You became a Trainer to become my guinea pig, did you not?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Illuminated by the setting sun, her eyes
shone with an eerie, yet innocent
light once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Whatever the case, it seemed her target races
wouldn't be changing on a whim anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The nearest middle-distance GⅠ race is the Osaka Hai.
Let's set our sights there first and aim for victory!
